body:
My experiences with Ultram began when the drug was first introduced to the US market back in the late 90's. I had a friend that worked for a spinal clinic and he would bring home samples. My first experience with Ultram was AMAZING, like others that have submitted on this subject, this did seem like the 'perfect drug'!! No overwhelming euphoria, no depressed respiration, no irritability once the 9 hour experience was over.
After years of on and off usage,
I had a clonic-tonic seizure in 2007 due to a massive dose of up to 15 50mg tablets (crazy and stupid I know)
. Ultram is still AMAZING though it does take more now (after 10 years) but remains by far my favorite for 'everyday use'.
